name: operator-kit
description: operator-kit: a Claude Code framework for an AI operator that turns strategy into dispatched GitHub-issue tasks for downstream worker repos. This marketplace ships the worker-side plugin.

plugins.name: operator-worker
plugins.description: Downstream worker side of the operator-kit dispatch pipeline: the working-agent-tasks + raising-issues skills and /work-queue command that pick up operator-dispatched `agent-task` GitHub issues and drive them to merged, closed-out PRs via the shared label/PR contract — attended or autonomous, using each repo's own development methodology.
